challenge.name: NAVIN AITC portable competition kit
challenge.goal: Reproduce a safe, contract-first Codex and Orca competition environment on another Windows machine.

must_have: Secret-free portable profiles, skills, wrappers, settings templates and version manifests
Exactly two local-only Lavish decision artifacts before implementation
A canonical machine-readable project contract and a machine-readable FE/BE boundary contract
Two isolated writer worktrees with a real early integration canary around minute 40-50
Repo-root, origin and AI Log hook invariants for official work
Route verification by model, endpoint, harness and tool-call smoke
Separate deploy, push, AI Log submit, AI Log readback and final submission gates
out_of_scope: Raw user homes, credentials, sessions, browser profiles, logs, databases or caches
Automatic secret entry or provider fallback
Treating Git push success as AI Log verification

architecture.integration_strategy: Independent FE and BE worktrees meet at a real vertical-slice canary around minute 40-50, then continue in parallel before full integration.

decisions: Canonical JSON is authoritative; Markdown files are human-readable views.
An early real integration canary is mandatory before either lane finishes all remaining scope.
Lavish is pinned and local-only during competition.
Live key information controls concurrency; DRILL defaults to 2 active model turns and OFFICIAL defaults to 6 while preserving headroom.
Model catalog presence alone never proves a route compatible.
AI Log verification requires submit status 202 and readback for the same current Codex session.
acceptance: Contract and lock drift fail closed.
Wrong cwd, missing origin or missing AI Log hooks fail official readiness.
Remote Lavish dependencies and unpinned Lavish versions fail validation.
Unverified model, endpoint or harness combinations are rejected.
A failed early integration canary blocks scope expansion.
Push success without same-session AI Log readback blocks final readiness.
tasks: Validate and lock canonical and boundary contracts
Run official repo-root and provider preflight
Build FE and BE independently from the locked boundary contract
Run and record the minute 40-50 integration canary
Finish lanes and run full integration and E2E
Review spec, engineering and BTC provenance independently
Deploy, push, submit logs, read back same-session events, then submit
